pilot_requirements: Freeze exact model snapshot, configuration and tokenizer; supply a reachable authenticated provider endpoint.
Quote and freeze a monetary ceiling from endpoint prices and calibrated per-call usage before 11,520 turns plus tool cycles.
Author and freeze 24 independent engineering scenario families with event schedules, gold and answerability ledgers; obtain domain review.
Integrate checked ModelContextBuilder messages with a metered provider runner, real registered tools, scripted clock/events and raw attempt logs.
Validate six separate end-to-end collection/scoring calibration cases and reconcile provider usage before running the pilot.
Assign two blinded assessors and retain calibration/adjudication records for every primary decision answer.
limits: Synthetic history fixtures are not an independently authored pilot corpus.
A native packet diagnostic is not an end-to-end model-session experiment.
Provider usage, empirical correctness, objection retention and qualification retention are unavailable, not zero.
Production adoption and confirmatory adequacy remain unestablished.
